INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Your data is safe. Try again; if it keeps happening, open the log folder from the Help menu.
FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission for this action.
INVALID_CREDENTIALS: Wrong username or password, or the account is disabled.
USERNAME_TAKEN: That username is already in use.
LAST_ACTIVE_ADMIN: The last active administrator cannot be deactivated or demoted.
LOG_FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE: The log folder could not be opened.
LOAD_FAILED: The application could not load its settings. Close and reopen the application.
CUSTOMER_NAME_OR_PHONE_REQUIRED: Enter the customer name or phone number.
PLATE_EXISTS: That plate number is already registered to another vehicle.
INVALID_BRAND_MODEL: The model does not belong to the selected brand.
REFERENCE_INACTIVE: The selected reference entry is inactive.
REFERENCE_DUPLICATE: That name or code is already in use.
REFERENCE_CODE_IMMUTABLE: The code cannot be changed after creation.
ALREADY_OWNER: This customer already owns the vehicle.
OWNERSHIP_TRANSFER_TOO_SOON: Ownership was just recorded. Wait a moment and try again.
DUPLICATE_SKU: That SKU is already used by another item.
UNKNOWN_BARCODE: Unknown barcode. No item was created.
CATALOG_ITEM_INACTIVE: This item is inactive and cannot be sold.
PRICE_START_CONFLICT: A price already starts at that exact time for this channel. Choose another time, or correct that price instead.
CORRECTION_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter the reason for the correction.
PRICE_CORRECTION_TARGET_INVALID: That price can no longer be corrected. Reload and try again.
PRICE_PREVIEW_STALE: Prices changed since the preview. Review the new preview before applying.
PRICE_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The preview expired. Preview the change again.
REASON_REQUIRED: Enter the reason for this stock change.
OPENING_BALANCE_EXISTS: This item already has stock history, so an opening balance cannot be set. Use receive, adjust or set stock instead.
ITEM_NOT_INVENTORY_TRACKED: This item does not track inventory (services never move stock).
TRACKING_LOCKED_BY_LEDGER: Inventory tracking cannot be changed because this item already has stock movements.
IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already used for a different action. Reload and try again.
SALE_ALREADY_RECORDED: Stock for this invoice and item was already recorded.
SALE_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: The stock sale entry was not found.
SALE_ALREADY_REVERSED: This sale's stock was already returned.
INVALID_QUANTITY: Enter a whole quantity of at least 1.
DRAFT_DISCARDED: This draft was discarded and can no longer be changed.
INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT: This invoice is no longer a draft.
DRAFT_VERSION_CONFLICT: Someone else changed this draft. Reload it and try again.
PRICE_REQUIRED: This item has no price for the channel and pricing time. Enter a selling price.
UNIT_PRICE_NOT_EXPECTED: This item already has a price. Add it first, then change the price on the line.
DRAFT_PRICE_REFRESH_STALE: Prices changed since the preview. Review the new preview before applying.
MECHANIC_ONLY_FOR_SERVICE: A mechanic can only be assigned to a service line.
LINE_NOT_FOUND: This line no longer exists in the draft.
LINE_TITLE_NOT_EDITABLE: The title of a catalog item cannot be changed on the line.
ALLOCATION_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT: The planned payments exceed the invoice total.
AD_HOC_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: The custom item was not found.
AD_HOC_REFERENCE_TYPE_MISMATCH: The custom item has a different type.
INVALID_TOP_DAYS: Enter TOP as a whole number of days (0 or more).
DRAFT_EMPTY: The transaction has no items yet.
INVOICE_DATE_IN_FUTURE: The invoice date {{invoiceDate}} is in the future (today is {{today}}). Change the invoice date.
ZERO_TOTAL_WITH_ALLOCATIONS: The total is zero, so no payment can be recorded. Remove the planned payments.
FINALIZE_WARNINGS_CHANGED: The warnings changed since you reviewed them. Review the checkout again.
PAYMENT_EXCEEDS_OUTSTANDING: The payment is more than the outstanding amount. Enter at most this invoice's remaining balance.
INVOICE_VOID: This invoice is void, so it cannot receive payments.
INVOICE_NOT_FINALIZED: This invoice is not finalized yet. Finish the transaction first.
PAID_INVOICE_CANNOT_BE_VOIDED: An invoice that has received a payment cannot be voided.
VOID_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason for the void.
